help.title: What the colours mean
help.toggle: Help mode: explain the colours (? or F1)
help.view.title: In the 3D view
help.view.pick: Cyan cross and ring: the point you clicked
help.view.ruler: Yellow line: the ruler; faint while it is still following the mouse
help.heat.even: Nothing drawn where both sides are even.
help.heat.teams: Each group has its own hue; where groups overlap the colours mix, and an even contest goes grey. The list of groups shows each hue.
help.heat.teamsGrey: Grey: rows with no group (empty, 0, none or unknown)
help.team.boxes: Boxes: the hue is the team, the shade tells its members apart. The people list shows each colour.
help.team.trail: Trail: the person's colour, fading with age.
help.team.look: Whitish ray: where the person looks, fading toward its tip.
help.level.title: On the level
help.level.ground: Grey ground: grey on purpose, so all colour is data. Steep and low are darker, dark lines are contours
help.level.structure: Tint on structures: walls and buildings, see-through; the colour can be changed
help.level.grid: Grid: every tenth line is brighter; the centre lines are reddish along X and bluish along Z.
help.level.axes: Axis needles: X red, Y green, Z blue.
help.panels.title: In the panels
help.panels.good: Green: fine, or finished (coverage says Exact)
help.panels.caution: Orange: still working, or worth a look, such as rows left out
help.panels.bad: Red: too big, or an error
help.match.title: In the match panel
help.match.none: Grey: no side, a draw, or the world
help.match.notIn3d: These two colours are for the panel only: in the 3D view the hues follow the groups, and T can be any of them.
help.match.rounds: Round strip: the colour says which side won.
help.match.reasons: Its letter says how: B bomb, D defused, K everyone killed, T time, S surrender, = draw, ? other.
help.match.after: A faded kill: after the round was decided. Red team: a teamkill.
help.match.plus: Green in the ± column: more kills than deaths
help.match.minus: Red in the ± column: more deaths than kills
help.race.noWheels: These laps carry no values per wheel.
help.race.travel: Bar at the wheel: suspension travel
help.race.brake: Disc on the wheel: brake temperature
help.race.load: Post beside the wheel: load on it
help.race.lapColour: Body and driven line: the lap's colour
help.race.followed: White ring on the ground: the car the camera follows
help.race.lamps: Lamps over the car, and the buttons on its card: lit while on
help.race.why: Why map, and the numbered badges: what the time went on
help.race.mistakes: Mistake map: how many laps made one here
help.race.strips: The two strips over the charts are the time map and the why map, along the lap.
